issues.source_quote: Со стихийным бедствием! - То есть? - С новым директором!
issues.translation_quote: On what? - The natural disaster! The new director!
issues.justification: The joke ('congratulations on the natural disaster... i.e., the new director') is garbled; the 'То есть?' setup is dropped and the equivalence of disaster and director is lost.

issues.source_quote: Три куба на то тёсу.
issues.translation_quote: That'll take three cubic yards of timber.
issues.justification: Fyodor Petrovich's bookkeeping quip is rendered with an invented, unnatural unit. It also loses the comedic point that he reacts to the 'terem' as a budget item.

issues.source_quote: Выходит докладчик!
issues.translation_quote: A speaker! A speaker comes out!
issues.justification: Elsewhere the same character is rendered inconsistently as 'speaker', 'address' and 'lecturer'. 'Speaker' also loses the Soviet 'report-giver' (доклад) sense, so the running gag about the dull report is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Не такое оно у меня уж и серое, как вы думаете, товарищ Усиков?!
issues.translation_quote: It's not nearly as gray as you think, Comrade Usikov!
issues.justification: The remark itself is fine, but 'Не такое оно... серое' is a sensitive pun on Ogurtsov's self-regard; the translation does not mark his pompous tone. Minor loss, but he also drops the pun 'Огурцов' = cucumber. Overall the character-name humor is untranslated.

issues.source_quote: А и Б играли на трубе!
issues.translation_quote: Just tooting away!
issues.justification: This is a quote from a well-known Russian children's riddle/rhyme ('А и Б сидели на трубе'), used to mock the orchestra. The allusion and its absurd comic effect are lost.

issues.source_quote: Нужно, чтоб музыка тебя так сказать.. Брала! ... Но в тоже время и не уводила..
issues.translation_quote: grab you! It should, as they say, lead you somewhere! But at the same time, not lead you astray.
issues.justification: The bureaucratic nonsense is partly kept but 'вела/уводила' wordplay is flattened; acceptable, but 'lead you somewhere' weakens the pun.

issues.source_quote: Вот, видите ли, одна, совсем одна... С моим здоровым коллективом! Вот так, Аделоида Кузьминична, будет типично.
issues.translation_quote: "alone, all alone..." "With my healthy collective!" There, Adeloida Kuzminichna. That's more typical.
issues.justification: The joke is that Ogurtsov 'corrects' the song's lyric ('I'm alone with hope and dreams') into a collectivist one. The translation reproduces the words but muddles the structure; 'typical' also fails to carry the Soviet 'типично' propaganda tag consistently.

issues.source_quote: Пять минут, пять минут... Новый год, он не ждёт
issues.translation_quote: The New Year won't wait; it's almost at the door.
issues.justification: Song lyrics are reworked heavily; the lyric 'Вот сидит паренёк, без пяти минут он- мастер!' is rendered as 'almost a master craftsman', losing the idiom 'без пяти минут' linked to the five-minute theme.

issues.source_quote: Горько, горько! - Что? Горько товарищи, чувствовать, что мы стали на год старше
issues.translation_quote: - Kiss! Kiss! - What? - It is bitter, comrades, to feel we've grown a year older.
issues.justification: The pun on 'Горько!' (wedding toast demanding a kiss) vs. 'bitter' is only partly carried; the translator uses 'Kiss!' then 'bitter', so the wordplay disappears.

issues.source_quote: Здрасте, тётя Дуся! - Леночка, на репетиции была, мне очень понравилось!
issues.translation_quote: Lena, I saw the rehearsal. I loved it!
issues.justification: The speaker is Aunt Dusya, who says she was at the rehearsal; the translation attributes the lines inconsistently, and the Russian dialogue pattern (greeting, then Dusya's remark) is blurred.

issues.source_quote: Больше ничего известный- неизвестный не сказал?
issues.translation_quote: Did this stranger you know say anything else?
issues.justification: The oxymoron 'известный-неизвестный' is a playful way of saying 'this known-unknown (obviously Grisha)'. The translation garbles it into an awkward phrase.

issues.source_quote: Я не знаю, как начать, в общем значит, так сказать
issues.translation_quote: I don't know where to start... Well, that is, so to speak...
issues.justification: Song lyric rendered as clunky prose with ellipses; loses rhythm and the sung quality.

issues.source_quote: Сурьёзный человек таким образом не поедет!
issues.translation_quote: No serious person would ride it.
issues.justification: The marked mispronunciation 'сурьёзный' (Ogurtsov's recurring verbal tic) is lost throughout; his character voice is flattened to standard English.

issues.source_quote: Ансамбль пенсии и пляски! Виноват, простите, ансамль Песни и пляски!
issues.translation_quote: The Retirement Song and Dance Ensemble! Sorry! The Song and Dance Ensemble!
issues.justification: The pun 'пенсии/песни' (pension/song) is not reproduced; the slip is not funny in English.

issues.source_quote: Из директора, понимаешь Петрушку делают?!
issues.translation_quote: They're making a clown of the director!
issues.justification: Petrushka is a specific puppet-theatre buffoon; generic 'clown' loses the cultural image, though meaning is acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Тося Бурыкину ... Тосю Буракину
issues.translation_quote: Tosya Burykina ... Tosya Burykina
issues.justification: The announcer's deliberate name slip is not reproduced, losing a small joke.

issues.source_quote: Ну что ж, неплохо, неплохо
issues.translation_quote: Not bad, not bad.
issues.justification: Fine, but Ogurtsov's bureaucratic cliché register ('так сказать', 'нетипично') is rendered unevenly; 'It's not typical!' sounds odd in English.

issues.source_quote: Яркая речь!
issues.translation_quote: What a stirring speech!
issues.justification: Lena's reply is sarcastic about Grisha's stammering; 'stirring' is too earnest and loses the irony.

issues.source_quote: Хотела бутерброд с сыром, но думаю, бутерброд не пройдёт
issues.translation_quote: I wanted a cheese sandwich, but it wouldn't fit through the gap.
issues.justification: The joke is 'a sandwich won't get through (the gap)' vs. sausages; the added 'gap' is acceptable, but the follow-up about cabbage/pasta sausages is garbled.

issues.source_quote: Вы за это ответите!Я буду жаловаться в ВЦСПС!
issues.translation_quote: I'll complain to the trade union council!
issues.justification: Later the translation uses 'All-Union Central Council of Trade Unions' for the same body, which is inconsistent terminology.

issues.source_quote: Шекспир, только не помню точно, какая вещь.
issues.translation_quote: Shakespeare. I just can't remember which play.
issues.justification: The humor is Kostya/Tosya passing off a love confession as Shakespeare; fine, but the following 'Why did you stop broadcasting Shakespeare?' lacks the deadpan setup.
